changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Rebuilt the non-batched profile from immutable DS4 revision c1d4597 with current DSpark sampling and verification code.
Kept bounded validation at greedy temperature zero; opportunistic and exact sampled decoding remain outside accepted recipe claims.
Advanced the antirez repository revision while retaining the exact unchanged Flash 0731 target and drafter objects.
Kept the recipe Candidate pending physical DGX Spark CUDA, DSpark statistics, memory, latency, and response-quality canaries.
Mounted the target and DSpark companion at distinct immutable runtime paths so DS4 receives the intended files.
Added a non-batched single-Spark DSpark latency profile that actually enables the pinned experimental drafter for greedy decoding.
Published as Candidate pending physical GB10 build, DSpark statistics, memory, latency, and response-quality canaries.
